note: Registry engines llgenie deliberately ships no skill/image for (issue #229). registry-sync carries every engine upstream lists, and rank_engines drops an engine with no image, so an engine with no skill must be a DECISION here - dated and reasoned - or it is not a decision at all. An engine in data/models.json with no skills/engines/<id>/SKILL.md and no entry here is NEW AND UNRESOLVED: `make check-engine-skill-gap` fails naming it, and the weekly registry-sync opens one tracking issue for it. Entries for an engine that later ships a skill, or that upstream stops listing, are stale: delete them (the gate fails until you do).

mlx-serve.reason: Apple-Silicon MLX server: Metal cannot run in a container, so it needs a native Metal skill, not an image. llgenie's Metal path already covers MLX with the `mlx` skill.

oMLX.reason: Apple-Silicon MLX server: Metal-only, so it needs a native Metal skill rather than a container image, and the `mlx` skill already serves MLX natively.

omlx-exl3.reason: Apple-Silicon server for ExL3 quants: Metal-only, so it needs a native Metal skill; the format is not one llgenie ships an image for yet.

ExLlamaV3.reason: The upstream family llgenie already ships, as the ROCm fork skill `exllamav3-rocm`; the upstream CUDA build has no pinned release and no verified install recipe yet.

MegaCapybara.reason: Auto-registered CUDA server with no pinned release to build an image from: it needs a verified upstream build recipe before it can become a skill.

llama.cpp (LlamAmpere fork).reason: llgenie ships stock llama.cpp plus the Prism and LaurentZuijdwijk forks; a third llama.cpp fork is not added unless it offers something the two shipped forks do not.

glm-flash-lite.reason: Auto-registered CUDA server with no pinned release to build an image from: it needs a verified upstream build recipe before it can become a skill.

Project Maya.reason: Auto-registered CUDA server with no pinned release to build an image from: it needs a verified upstream build recipe before it can become a skill.
